title: Real-valued form of a Boolean function
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, regard its values as real numbers via the sign-to-real identification. This defines a real-valued function whose values all lie in $[-1,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the two signs
